formatTime.value: (iso) => { if (!iso) return ''; var d = new Date(iso); var pad = function(n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); }; return d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(d.getDate()) + ' ' + pad(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes()); }

isCorrectAnswer.value: (idx, item) => { if (!item.answer || !item.options) return false; var correctLetters = item.answer.toUpperCase().split(''); var currentLetter = String.fromCharCode(65 + idx); return correctLetters.includes(currentLetter); }

loadStats.value: async () => { try { const res = await window.__VTJ_AUTH__.apiFetch('/api/collection/stats', { headers: this.getJsonHeaders() }); if (res.ok) { this.state.stats = await res.json(); } } catch(e) {} }

loadFavorites.value: async () => { this.state.loading = true; try { var url = '/api/collection/' + (this.state.activeTab === 'news' ? 'news-favorites' : 'question-favorites') + '?page=' + this.state.page + '&page_size=' + this.state.pageSize; const res = await window.__VTJ_AUTH__.apiFetch(url, { headers: this.getJsonHeaders() }); if (res.ok) { const data = await res.json(); this.state.total = data.total || 0; if (this.state.activeTab === 'news') { this.state.newsFavorites = data.items || []; } else { this.state.questionFavorites = data.items || []; } } } catch(e) {} finally { this.state.loading = false; } }

viewNewsDetail.value:
async (item) => { if (item.fav_type === 'quote') { this.state.newsDetail = { id: 0, title: '申论金句', source: item.source || '', category: item.category || '', publish_date: '', content: '

' + item.content + '

', images: [], url: '' }; this.state.showNewsModal = true; return; } try { const res = await fetch('/api/news/' + item.news_id); if (res.ok) { this.state.newsDetail = await res.json(); this.state.showNewsModal = true; } } catch(e) {} }

removeNewsFavorite.value: async (newsId) => { if (!newsId) return; try { await window.__VTJ_AUTH__.apiFetch('/api/news/' + newsId + '/favorite', { method: 'POST', headers: this.getJsonHeaders() }); this.state.showNewsModal = false; this.loadFavorites(); this.loadStats(); } catch(e) {} }

removeQuestionFavorite.value: async (favId) => { if (!favId) return; try { await window.__VTJ_AUTH__.apiFetch('/api/collection/q_' + favId, { method: 'DELETE', headers: this.getJsonHeaders() }); this.state.showQuestionModal = false; this.loadFavorites(); this.loadStats(); } catch(e) {} }
